scope: Bounded exact-recipient notification group summaries with stored counts and authorized latest-item projection

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_scope: one exact non-nil tenant and recipient supplied by an authorized caller
policy.group_scope: only stored non-null groups with at least one non-archived row
policy.ordering: latest non-archived created_at descending then UUID descending
policy.page_bounds: default 20 and hard maximum 64 raw groups
policy.cursor: reuse the versioned i1 timestamp-nanosecond and UUID cursor
policy.item_count: exact stored count of non-archived rows in the group
policy.unread_count: exact stored count of unread rows in the group
policy.latest_item: typed inbox read model for the latest non-archived row without a target route
policy.authorization: latest row must pass current recipient privacy before source target authorization
policy.sparse_progress: suppressed groups are omitted while continuation follows the last scanned raw group
policy.empty_foreign_result: missing archived-only and foreign tenant or recipient scopes return an empty page
policy.failure: retryable recipient-policy or source failure aborts the page without a partial result
policy.count_consistency: counts reflect stored owner state and converge after reconciliation archives unavailable rows
policy.mutation_boundary: summary reads change no state timestamp or delivery attempt
policy.transport_boundary: no HTTP GraphQL native server function admin or storefront adapter is delivered

not_delivered: group-level mark-read mark-unread and archive commands
external inbox transport and grouped UI adapters
tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
search index SEO and deep-link migration
PostgreSQL runtime execution and cross-consumer evidence
